title: Account overview: contacts, both kinds of orders, paid orders and luggage
description: A passenger who already has an account signs in and looks through their saved contacts. They reload their orders twice — once for the GaoTie/DongChe (high-speed) trains and once for ordinary trains of the 'Other' type, which the system keeps apart — and then reload them again showing only the orders with the 'Paid' status. Last, they check which luggage consignments are registered on their account. They do not search, book or pay for anything.

steps.action: Sign in with a username and a password
Go to the list of saved contacts
Reload my orders for GaoTie/DongChe (high-speed) trains
Reload my orders for ordinary trains of the 'Other' type
Reload the orders again, showing only those with the 'Paid' status
Check which luggage consignments are registered on my account
